title: Sparse Optimizer Diagnostic

sparse_adam_availability.current_installation: diff-gaussian-rasterization 0.0.0 is installed without the accel extras
sparse_adam_availability.note: gsplat does not natively provide SparseGaussianAdam. The diff-gaussian-rasterization package provides an accelerated rasterizer and sparse Adam optimizer, but requires a separate installation that was not completed for this baseline.
sparse_adam_availability.expected_compatibility: Sparse Gaussian Adam uses a different parameter layout where each Gaussian has its own learning rate state. It is compatible with gsplat's rendering API but uses different parameter groups and optimizer logic.

recommendation: If SparseGaussianAdam is needed for a baseline comparison, install with: pip install diff-gaussian-rasterization[3dgs_accel]. Then create a separate baseline config using gsplat's DefaultStrategy (which supports per-parameter group LR scheduling). This is distinct from the current REFERENCE_V1 which uses a single persistent Adam.
effort_estimate: LOW: 1-2 days for installation + integration + validation.
